491:t_1:8.en:
$$ブライト$$
「We were also able to separate $$ザフト$$ from $$ネオ・ジオン$$, which means $$ネオ・ジオン$$'s combat strength has been cut in half.」

491:t_1:9.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Also, Ensign $$リディ$$'s survival has been confirmed, but he now pilots a black $$ユニコーンガンダム$$ called $$バンシィ$$ and has become captain of an action unit of the $$クロノ$$ Conservatives.」

491:t_1:10.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Those same $$クロノ$$ forces used Vice Foreign Minister $$リリーナ・ドーリアン$$ as a hostage to pressure us into surrendering, but we succeeded in protecting the Vice Foreign Minister.」

491:t_1:12.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Yes... Each of the Gundams has also begun to display its full capabilities.」

491:t_1:13.en:
$$ブライト$$
「But all of this power is meaningless if the world is destroyed.」

491:t_1:14.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「The destruction of the world... I can't read $$アマルガム$$'s intentions at all...」

491:t_1:15.en:
$$ブライト$$
「I believe the answer lies where we are headed.」

491:t_1:16.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「If the rendezvous point is off $$相模湾$$, then...」

491:t_1:17.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Most likely, the site of the final battle with $$アマルガム$$ will be the ruins of $$第３新東京市$$.」

491:t_1:18.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「...So you're saying the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$ and the $$クォーター$$ have grasped $$アマルガム$$'s ultimate objective?」

491:t_1:19.en:
$$ブライト$$
「We don't know the details either. The transmission from Captain $$テスタロッサ$$ only conveyed an emergency and the rendezvous point.」

491:t_1:20.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「Then we have no choice but to hear the details after we rendezvous.」

491:t_1:21.en:
$$ブライト$$
「As for the war in space, we managed to secure the cooperation of the group of $$ハマーン・カーン$$ that broke away from $$ネオ・ジオン$$.」

491:t_1:22.en:
$$ブライト$$
「We were also able to separate $$ザフト$$ from $$ネオ・ジオン$$, which means $$ネオ・ジオン$$'s combat strength has been cut in half.」

491:t_1:23.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Also, Ensign $$リディ$$'s survival has been confirmed, but he now pilots a black $$ユニコーンガンダム$$ called $$バンシィ$$ and has become captain of an action unit of the $$クロノ$$ Conservatives.」

491:t_1:24.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Those same $$クロノ$$ forces used Vice Foreign Minister $$リリーナ・ドーリアン$$ as a hostage to pressure us into surrendering, but we succeeded in protecting the Vice Foreign Minister.」

491:t_1:26.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Yes... Each of the Gundams has also begun to display its full capabilities.」

491:t_1:27.en:
$$ブライト$$
「But all of this power is meaningless if the world is destroyed.」

491:t_1:28.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「The destruction of the world... I can't read $$アマルガム$$'s intentions at all...」

491:t_1:29.en:
$$ブライト$$
「I believe the answer lies where we are headed.」

491:t_1:30.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「If the rendezvous point is off $$相模湾$$, then...」

491:t_1:31.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Most likely, the site of the final battle with $$アマルガム$$ will be the ruins of $$第３新東京市$$.」

491:t_10:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...Good work out there, $$ギミー$$, $$ダリー$$... Now, now... how about some tea before your next sortie? There's cake, too.」

491:t_10:4.en:
$$ギミー$$
「W-What's with you, AG...? Being all nice out of nowhere is creepy...」

491:t_10:5.en:
$$ダリー$$
「Oh, I get it. It's because we produced $$Ｚチップ$$, so you're giving us the royal treatment, right?」

491:t_10:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Exactly right. Thanks to the two of your teamwork in that last battle, $$Ｚチップ$$ worth 100 Z were produced.」

491:t_10:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I'll add this to the squad's stock.」

491:t_10:8.en:
$$ギミー$$
「Heh heh... $$ダリー$$ and I make the best combination, after all.」

491:t_10:12.en:
$$ダリー$$
「Back in Mom's belly, we were originally just one person, weren't we...」

491:t_10:13.en:
$$ギミー$$
「But I'm glad. Because we split apart, I got to meet you, $$ダリー$$.」

491:t_10:15.en:
$$ギミー$$
「'Cause without you, I'd be in trouble with nobody to back me up.」

491:t_10:16.en:
$$ダリー$$
「Honestly! No matter how much time passes, you're still such a handful!」

491:t_10:17.en:
$$ダリー$$
「Do you get it, $$ギミー$$? With $$キタン$$ gone, it's up to us to do our best as the vanguard of $$大グレン団$$.」

491:t_10:18.en:
$$ダリー$$
「And yet you keep on talking like a child like that...」

491:t_10:20.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「The more they fight, the closer they are. It's heartwarming to watch.」

491:t_10:21.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(But that is not the only reason for the special service.)

491:t_10:22.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(The two of you not only helped $$タケル$$, but also helped me greatly in understanding the essence of the $$いがみ合う双子$$.)

491:t_10:24.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(I believe this fact will surely become the answer to the question inside me...)

491:t_10:29.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「AG! Give me some ice cream!」

491:t_10:30.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes, thank you for your business. But the briefing is about to start. Is it all right to be eating this?」

491:t_10:31.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「It's not me who's eating it. It's $$グーラ$$.」

491:t_10:33.en:
$$正太郎$$
「It seems $$グーラ$$ couldn't forget the taste of the ice cream he had when he was staying with us.」

491:t_10:34.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I see... In that case, I'll give you the toppings on the house.」

491:t_10:38.en:
$$グーラ$$
「I get everything I want. That is my way.」

491:t_10:39.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「What the heck, $$グーラ$$! You haven't changed at all since you were a prince!」

491:t_10:41.en:
$$正太郎$$
「Let's learn about things like that together with us, $$グーラ$$.」

491:t_10:43.en:
$$勝平$$
「All right! Then leave it to the great $$勝平$$, leader of the $c Boys' Brigade!」

491:t_10:44.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Since when has there been such a group...!?」

491:t_10:45.en:
$$勝平$$
「First, I'll teach you the rules for newcomers.」

491:t_10:47.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「...Then, with me, AG, presiding, we shall begin $$グーラ$$'s induction ceremony!」

491:t_10:48.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then let's give it our all again today...!」

491:t_10:52.en:
$$ワッ太$$
「Isn't it fine? $$グーラ$$ seems to be enjoying himself, too.」

491:t_10:53.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now then, the ceremony being over, let us all have ice cream together. It's my treat today.」

491:t_10:54.en:
$$勝平$$
「Then I'll have... all the toppings!」

491:t_10:56.en:
$$グーラ$$
($c... A world I never knew until now...)

491:t_10:57.en:
$$グーラ$$
(Father... I will live on together with $$正太郎$$ and the others... To atone for what I have done, and for the future of the universe...)

491:t_10:58.en:
$$グーラ$$
(And someday, I swear I will free you from the depths of darkness.)

492:t_000:1.en:
$$凱$$
「All right! Blue sky and blue sea!」

492:t_000:2.en:
$$渓$$
「For a while there, I wondered what was going to happen, though.」
